notes.text: Angela Dorothea Merkel is a German stateswoman and retired politician who served as Chancellor of Germany from 2005 to 2021.
Angela Merkel is the only woman to have held the office and the only from former East Germany.
Angela Merkel was Leader of the Opposition from 2002 to 2005 and Leader of the Christian Democratic Union (CDU) from 2000 to 2018.
Angela Merkel is remembered as a politician connected with Germany.
Angela Merkel's recorded life dates place this profile around born 1954.
